title: Machine Learning Engineer
body:
Halcyon builds forecasting tools for energy traders.

Responsibilities
- Ship models to production and own them afterwards
- Work with traders to turn intuitions into features

What we're looking for
- 3-5 years shipping machine learning systems
- Strong Python and PyTorch
- Comfortable owning a service in production

Bonus points
- Time series forecasting experience
- Familiarity with Kubernetes

We are an equal opportunity employer.
